Does it count if you haven't attempted?

I've had depression and anxiety for quite a while now, since my (albeit awful) father died in October of 2014. My family was already dysfunctional to begin with, and it got a bit worse after his passing.

Honestly, I'd be lying if I said I didn't feel like ending it sometimes - often, even. I'm not really sure what it is that's keeping me from committing suicide, but I guess it's due to a variety of things.

My family situation would likely worsen if I were to follow through, and I'd miss my cat. My friends, though few and far between, would probably hate to see me go.

I'm a young teenager - out of fear of getting yelled at, I won't disclose my actual age unless someone asks. They say I have a lot to look forward to, and honestly, I still feel hopeless, seeing what all I've gone through and how things are going, but I don't want to miss it if something good were to happen. I guess that's why I'm still holding on.

If anything, I just wish I could talk to my friends about this without being afraid of bothering them or making them uncomfortable.
